## Global Rules

- `All platform implementations must use canonical tokens for color/spacing/radius/typography/radius/elevation values.`
- `No inline hardcoded style tokens are allowed in core surface containers without a documented exception in migration evidence.`
- `Interaction states must be consistent: default / hover / press / focus / disabled / loading / empty / error where applicable.`
- `Safe-area and platform form-factor differences are allowed only at the container and navigation level.`

## Violation Rules

### `raw-color-literal`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Core implementation evidence must not introduce raw hex/rgb/hsl/named semantic platform colors instead of DS color tokens.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `raw-spacing-or-sizing-scalar`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Layout, spacing, radius, dimensions, and opacity in covered contracts must resolve to design tokens or approved token classes.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `raw-typography`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Typography in covered contracts must use DS text styles, generated font tokens, or approved token-backed web classes.
- Machine detection: `webPatterns, iosPatterns`

### `missing-token-family-evidence`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Every required token family and explicit requiredTokenUsage entry must be present in implementation evidence for screen contracts.
- Machine detection: `source`

### `missing-contract-evidence`

- Severity: `error`
- Applies to: `web`, `ios`
- Description: Mandatory screen contracts must declare readable implementationEvidence files for every supported platform.
- Machine detection: `source`

## Evidence Requirements

- mandatoryScreens: Each mandatory screen contract must list readable implementationEvidence files for every platform it declares. Remember-style primitives and screen layouts apply to iOS/Android; existing web evidence remains unchanged.
- tokenFamilies: Evidence files must contain every token family listed in requiredTokenFamilies, using platform-appropriate generated tokens or token-backed class names.
- explicitTokenUsage: Evidence files must contain every token reference listed in requiredTokenUsage unless the contract declares a documented exception.
- violationReporting: Verifier output must name the contract, platform, violated rule, and source pattern or missing token reference.
- documentation: Run npm run generate-contract-docs after contract changes; generated docs must describe required surfaces, violation rules, evidence requirements, and per-contract token expectations.

### `app-shell`

- Type: `primitive`
- Mandatory: `true`

Required token families:

- `DSColor`
- `DSLayout`
- `DSRadius`
- `DSOpacity`
- `DSSpace`

Required token usage:

- surfaceLayers: `DSColor.background`, `DSColor.surface`
- layout: `DSLayout.screenPadMobile`, `DSLayout.screenPadTablet`, `DSLayout.safeBottomNavHeight`

- interaction: `DSOpacity.surfaceSubtle`, `DSOpacity.surfaceStrong`

Implementation evidence:

- ios: `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/RootView.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Login/LoginView.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Login/NativeSignUpView.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/DesignSystem/DSAdaptiveLayout.swift`

Rules:

Copy ends in the ~요 form.`

- `Pinned notices render first; flat post sections have sectionGap spacing. Keep the banner slot after the first post and preserve likes, comments, inline expansion and analytics.`
- `Web retains its existing hero/sidebar layout; Remember-style blocks apply only to iOS/Android.`
- `Load failures stay calm (spec 0.3/0.4): no red cards or text, no server/network wording, no internal numbers and no 다시 시도 / 다시 불러오기 buttons; use the stateView template. First-load failure: 소식을 불러오지 못했어요 / 화면을 아래로 당겨 새로고침해 주세요. with the pull arrow; empty: 표시할 소식이 없어요 / 검색어나 카테고리를 바꿔 확인해 주세요.`
- `Pull-to-refresh reloads the first page; on success the list is replaced, on failure the existing list (or the calm state) stays with no message (spec 0.6). Android shows no red 새로고침하지 못했습니다 · 다시 시도 line.`
- `A failed next page keeps only the stateView loading row, retries silently after 2s and 4s (two more attempts), then hides the row until the user reaches the list end again or pulls to refresh (spec 0.6, proposed defaults).`
- `Expanded body failure is one grey line 내용을 불러오지 못했어요. 당겨서 새로고침해 주세요.; a missing post reads 삭제되었거나 볼 수 없는 소식이에요. without a number; a failed like silently reverts the optimistic state; a failed comment keeps the draft in the composer.`

- android: `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSComponents.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSRememberStyle.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/screens/TargetScreenDesignSystemBindings.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/screens/ScreenTokenMaps.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/alumni/ui/AlumniScreen.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSPersonRow.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSFilterRow.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSSegmentedTabs.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSChip.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSSectionBlock.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSSubHeader.kt`

Rules:

- `Header 동문 opens the existing inline search; presets 전체 동문 / 같은 기수 / 같은 직종 map to existing cohort/job filters.`
- `Filter row shows 전체 (N), 기수순 and 필터. Preserve filter sheet, sorting, paging and row selection.`
- `Detail retains 학교 / 직장 / 연락처 / 전문분야·태그, privacy badges, message/business-card actions, block/report and self handling.`
- `Load failures stay calm (spec 0.3/0.4): no red cards or text, no server/network wording, no internal numbers and no 다시 시도 / 다시 불러오기 buttons; use the stateView template. List failure: 동문 목록을 불러오지 못했어요 / 화면을 아래로 당겨 새로고침해 주세요. with the arrow; search with no results: 검색 결과가 없어요 / 검색어나 필터를 바꿔 다시 찾아보세요. without the arrow.`
- `Pull-to-refresh reloads the first page; on success the list is replaced, on failure the existing list (or the calm state) stays with no message (spec 0.6). A failed next page keeps only the stateView loading row, retries silently after 2s and 4s (two more attempts), then hides the row until the user reaches the list end again or pulls to refresh (spec 0.6, proposed defaults).`
- `Detail failure: 프로필을 불러오지 못했어요 / 잠시 후 다시 열어 주세요. without the arrow; business-card failure is one grey line 명함을 불러오지 못했어요. 잠시 후 다시 열어 주세요. with no button.`

Implementation evidence:

- ios: `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/DesignSystem/DSComponents.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Donation/DonationLinkView.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Donation/MyDonationTreeCard.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Donation/DonationTreeIllustration.swift`
- android: `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSComponents.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSRememberStyle.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/screens/TargetScreenDesignSystemBindings.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/screens/ScreenTokenMaps.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/donation/ui/DonationScreen.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/donation/ui/DonationSummarySection.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/donation/ui/MyDonationTreeCard.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/donation/ui/DonationTreeIllustration.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSActionButtons.kt`

Rules:

- `Native 기부 summary shows 장학회 전체 누적 기부, optional goal/progress, 이번 달 기부액 and optional 계좌 잔액.`
- `Hide the balance card when balanceAmount is absent; display 계좌 잔액 기준일 YYYY.MM.DD · 장학회 관리자 입력 when dated. Never render 참여 동문/donorCount.`
- `Keep 내 나무 and the 해피나눔에서 기부하기 external CTA; do not introduce an in-app payment flow.`
- `Summary failure (iOS I05 / Android I04) is calm: the cards show grey 기부 현황을 불러오지 못했어요 and 나의 기부 현황을 불러오지 못했어요 with one line above, 화면을 아래로 당겨 새로고침해 주세요.; the donate button stays. No red text or retry button.`
- `Pull-to-refresh reloads the first page; on success the list is replaced, on failure the existing list (or the calm state) stays with no message (spec 0.6).`
- `If the external browser cannot open (iOS I06), show one grey line under the button, 브라우저를 열지 못했어요. 잠시 후 다시 눌러 주세요., instead of an alert.`

- states: `DSEmptyState`, `DSStateView`, `DSLoadingState`

Implementation evidence:

- ios: `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/DesignSystem/DSComponents.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Notification/NotificationInboxView.swift`, `dflh-saf-v2-swift/Sources/App/Feature/Notification/NotificationInboxHeaderAction.swift`
- android: `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/notifications/ui/NotificationInboxScreen.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/app/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/app/feature/notifications/ui/NotificationInboxComponents.kt`, `dflh-saf-v2-kotlin/design-system/src/main/kotlin/com/dflh/designsystem/DSStateViews.kt`

Rules:

- `Header bell uses DSMainTabHeaderAction(showsDot:) with the shared unread dot; accessibility value 읽지 않은 알림 있음 while unread.`

- `Tapping a row closes the inbox and opens the linked feed post.`
- `Reference screens for the calm template (spec 0.4): empty F03 받은 알림이 없어요 / 새 소식이 올라오면 여기에서 알려 드릴게요., failure F04 알림을 불러오지 못했어요 / 화면을 아래로 당겨 새로고침해 주세요., both with the pull arrow and no retry button.`
- `Pull-to-refresh reloads the first page; on success the list is replaced, on failure the existing list (or the calm state) stays with no message (spec 0.6).`
- `A failed next page keeps only the stateView loading row, retries silently after 2s and 4s (two more attempts), then hides the row until the user reaches the list end again or pulls to refresh (spec 0.6, proposed defaults). The row reads 다음 알림을 불러오는 중… (F05).`
